item.title: EPAM Systems: Senior DevOps Engineer (DHDP)
item.description:
Headquarters: Armenia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan
URL: http://epam.com

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to support the Digital Health Data Platform (DHDP) by driving CI/CD, infrastructure automation, deployment, environment configuration, monitoring, and operational support across DEV, QA, PRE-PROD, and PROD. In this role, you will work closely with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Cloud/Infrastructure, Security, and QA teams to ensure DHDP changes are deployed securely, consistently, and according to established architecture, security, and change-management requirements.
